options.content:
**Ready = Unknown** → il control plane non riceve più l'heartbeat del nodo (Lease non rinnovato da > ~40s).
**Ready = NotReady** → il kubelet risponde ma si dichiara non pronto (runtime / CNI / PLEG).

**Prima guarda "Nodi NotReady/Unknown contemporaneamente":**
- **tutti i nodi insieme, per pochi minuti** → problema lato **control plane** (manager MKE / apiserver / etcd / LB) o di kube-state-metrics, **non dei nodi**. Verifica il pannello *Componenti control plane*.
- **uno o pochi nodi** → problema del singolo nodo, vedi sotto.

Per il singolo nodo, incrocia con *Raggiungibilità da Prometheus*:
- kubelet **DOWN** + node-exporter **DOWN** → nodo irraggiungibile: VM bloccata/spenta, ESXi, rete. Guarda *Riavvii*.
- kubelet **DOWN**, node-exporter **UP** → kubelet / runtime morto o bloccato (`ucp-kubelet`, dockerd/containerd).
- entrambi **UP** ma Unknown → percorso nodo ↔ apiserver (manager MKE, LB, firewall, certificati).
- **Riavvii > 0** → VM riavviata (eventi vCenter, `journalctl --list-boots`).

targets.expr: count(max by(node) (max_over_time((max by(node,status) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status=~"false|unknown", node=~"$node"}) == 1)[$__range:30s]))) or vector(0)

count(max by(nodename) (changes(node_boot_time_seconds[$__range]) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by(instance,nodename) (last_over_time(node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"}[$__range]))) > 0) or vector(0)

count(max by(node) (max_over_time((kube_node_status_condition{node=~"$node", status="true", condition=~"MemoryPressure|DiskPressure|PIDPressure|NetworkUnavailable"} == 1)[$__range:30s]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Nodi KO > 5 min cumulati nel periodo
panels.description: Esclude i flap brevi: conta solo i nodi rimasti NotReady/Unknown per più di 5 minuti in totale.

targets.expr: count(max by(node) (count_over_time((max by(node,status) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status=~"false|unknown", node=~"$node"}) == 1)[$__range:30s]) * 30) > 300) or vector(0)

panels.title: Nodi NotReady/Unknown contemporaneamente
panels.description: Se la barra arriva al totale dei nodi, il problema è del control plane (o di kube-state-metrics), non dei nodi.

targets.expr: count(max by(node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status=~"false|unknown", node=~"$node"} == 1)) or vector(0)
count(max by(node) (kube_node_info{node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Componenti control plane (raggiungibilità da Prometheus)
panels.description: Se kube-state-metrics è DOWN le metriche kube_* mancano: i 'buchi' non sono indisponibilità reali.

targets.expr: min by(job,instance) (up{job=~"apiserver|kube-state-metrics"})

panels.title: Stato Ready per nodo
panels.description: Una riga per nodo. Buco grigio = nessun dato (oggetto node assente o kube-state-metrics giù). Passa il mouse per vedere inizio/fine.

targets.expr: max by(node) ((kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="false", node=~"$node"} == 1) * 1 or (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="unknown", node=~"$node"} == 1) * 2 or (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true", node=~"$node"} == 1) * 0)

panels.title: Riepilogo indisponibilità nodi (periodo selezionato)
panels.description: Una riga per nodo coinvolto, ordinata per durata. Durate campionate ogni 30s. Episodi = numero di volte che il nodo è uscito da Ready.

targets.expr: count_over_time((max by(node,status) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status=~"false|unknown", node=~"$node"}) == 1)[$__range:30s]) * 30
min_over_time((timestamp(max by(node,status) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status=~"false|unknown", node=~"$node"}) == 1))[$__range:30s]) * 1000
max_over_time((timestamp(max by(node,status) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status=~"false|unknown", node=~"$node"}) == 1))[$__range:30s]) * 1000

((max by(node) (label_replace(changes(node_boot_time_seconds[$__range]) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by(instance,nodename) (last_over_time(node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"}[$__range])), "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))) or on(node) (max by(node) (max_over_time((max by(node,status) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status=~"false|unknown", node=~"$node"}) == 1)[$__range:30s])) * 0)) and on(node) max by(node) (max_over_time((max by(node,status) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status=~"false|unknown", node=~"$node"}) == 1)[$__range:30s]))

((count_over_time(((min by(node) (up{job="kubelet", metrics_path="/metrics", node=~"$node"}) == 0) + 1 == 1)[$__range:30s]) * 30) or on(node) (max by(node) (max_over_time((max by(node,status) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status=~"false|unknown", node=~"$node"}) == 1)[$__range:30s])) * 0)) and on(node) max by(node) (max_over_time((max by(node,status) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status=~"false|unknown", node=~"$node"}) == 1)[$__range:30s]))

((count_over_time(((min by(node) (label_replace(up{job="node-exporter"} * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by(instance,nodename) (last_over_time(node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"}[6h])), "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)")) == 0) + 1 == 1)[$__range:30s]) * 30) or on(node) (max by(node) (max_over_time((max by(node,status) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status=~"false|unknown", node=~"$node"}) == 1)[$__range:30s])) * 0)) and on(node) max by(node) (max_over_time((max by(node,status) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status=~"false|unknown", node=~"$node"}) == 1)[$__range:30s]))

ceil(changes((max by(node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status=~"false|unknown", node=~"$node"} == 1) or on(node) (max by(node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true", node=~"$node"}) * 0))[$__range:30s]) / 2) and on(node) max by(node) (max_over_time((max by(node,status) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status=~"false|unknown", node=~"$node"}) == 1)[$__range:30s]))

count by(node) (max by(node,pod) (max_over_time(kube_pod_info{namespace="$namespace", node=~"$node"}[$__range]))) and on(node) max by(node) (max_over_time((max by(node,status) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status=~"false|unknown", node=~"$node"}) == 1)[$__range:30s]))

panels.title: Raggiungibilità da Prometheus — kubelet vs node-exporter
panels.description: Raggiungibilità dei nodi da Prometheus. Distingue 'nodo irraggiungibile' da 'solo kubelet'.

targets.expr: min by(node) (up{job="kubelet", metrics_path="/metrics", node=~"$node"})

min by(node) (label_replace(up{job="node-exporter"} * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by(instance,nodename) (last_over_time(node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"}[6h])), "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Condizioni di pressure (solo se attive nel periodo)

targets.expr: max by(node,condition) (kube_node_status_condition{node=~"$node", status="true", condition=~"MemoryPressure|DiskPressure|PIDPressure|NetworkUnavailable"}) and on(node,condition) max by(node,condition) (max_over_time((kube_node_status_condition{node=~"$node", status="true", condition=~"MemoryPressure|DiskPressure|PIDPressure|NetworkUnavailable"} == 1)[$__range:30s]))

panels.title: Top container per picco RAM e CPU nel periodo
panels.description: Top 20 per RAM e top 20 per CPU (celle vuote = fuori dalla top 20 per quella risorsa). Ordina cliccando l'intestazione.

targets.expr:
topk(20,
  max by(namespace,pod,container,node) (max_over_time(container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", image!="", container!=""}[$__range:])
  * on(namespace,pod) group_left(node) max by(namespace,pod,node) (max_over_time(kube_pod_info{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", node=~"$node"}[$__range:])))
) / 1024^3

topk(20,
  max by(namespace,pod,container,node) (max_over_time(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", image!="", container!=""}[5m])[$__range:1m])
  * on(namespace,pod) group_left(node) max by(namespace,pod,node) (max_over_time(kube_pod_info{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", node=~"$node"}[$__range:])))
)

panels.title: Container riavviati nel periodo
panels.description: 137 = SIGKILL (OOM o liveness) · 143 = SIGTERM · 1 = errore applicativo.

targets.expr:
round(sum by(namespace,pod,container,node) (
  increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__range])
  * on(namespace,pod) group_left(node) max by(namespace,pod,node) (max_over_time(kube_pod_info{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", node=~"$node"}[$__range:]))
)) > 0

round(sum by(namespace,pod,container,node) (
  increase(container_oom_events_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__range])
  * on(namespace,pod) group_left(node) max by(namespace,pod,node) (max_over_time(kube_pod_info{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", node=~"$node"}[$__range:]))
)) > 0

max by(namespace,pod,container,reason) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", reason!=""} == 1) and on(namespace,pod,container) (sum by(namespace,pod,container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__range])) > 0)

max by(namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_exitcode{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) and on(namespace,pod,container) (sum by(namespace,pod,container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__range])) > 0)

max by(namespace,pod,node) (
  max_over_time((kube_pod_status_reason{namespace="$namespace", reason="Evicted"} == 1)[$__range:])
  * on(namespace,pod) group_left(node) max by(namespace,pod,node) (max_over_time(kube_pod_info{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", node=~"$node"}[$__range:]))
) > 0
sum by(node,operation_type) (rate(kubelet_runtime_operations_errors_total{node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0
sum by(node) (kubelet_running_pods{node=~"$node"})
sum by(node) (kubelet_running_containers{node=~"$node"})

panels.title: Durata PLEG relist p95
panels.description: > 3s in modo continuativo = runtime lento/bloccato → NotReady (PLEG is not healthy).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(node, le) (rate(kubelet_pleg_relist_duration_seconds_bucket{node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(node, le) (rate(kubelet_pod_start_duration_seconds_bucket{node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])))
